title: Le Chant du Veilleur
identity: Joaquín Nin, Le chant du veilleur (Wachterlied), for mezzo-soprano, violin or saxophone, and piano, M. Eschig c.1937. CiNii identifies Jean-Marie Londeix as transcriber of the saxophone part and describes a seven-page score plus two three-page parts.

evidence.claim: Opened CiNii Books record identifies Joaquín Nin’s Le chant du veilleur (Wachterlied), for mezzo-soprano, violin or saxophone and piano, published by M. Eschig c.1937. The note says the saxophone part was transcribed by Jean-Marie Londeix; the copy has a seven-page score and two three-page parts.

Opened BnF disc record documents a recording of the alto-saxophone version with mezzo-soprano Danielle Millet, saxophone Jean-Marie Londeix, and piano Henriette Puig-Roget. This verifies a performance/release record, not the content of audio playback.

collection_flag: A vocal chamber work with optional saxophone or violin. The saxophone part is a transcription credited to Jean-Marie Londeix, so the edition is not an original saxophone composition.
